values.name: Domestic
values.description: Domestic message as defined by relevant central bank.

values.description: Domestic message with requirement to regulatory information to central bank.

values.name: Economic area
values.description: Message crossing at least one national boundary but confined within a specific economic area (e.g. EC, EFTA ...).

values.description: International message as defined by relevant central bank.
